title: ZeroAI: on-chain crypto prediction snapshots with Pyth
summary: Initialise a vault of Pyth feed addresses and a games PDA, then publish a ZEROAI prediction that snapshots those oracles.
what: ZeroAI is an Anchor program that publishes ZEROAI's cryptocurrency price predictions on Solana. An admin creates a vault account holding six Pyth feed pubkeys, initialises a games PDA seeded by ["games", admin], and calls addgame with symbol and target-price vectors. addgame snapshots each Pyth feed if the price is no older than 60 seconds (otherwise it records 0). Upstream is the program only; the hosted app is Sol.College's generic IDL console pointed at this devnet deployment.
app_note: The fork has no first-party frontend. The page at /dapps/zeroai/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. The IDL was converted from Anchor 0.29 shape to the 0.30 console format.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/zeroai/, switch the console to Devnet, and connect Phantom or Solflare (set the wallet itself to Devnet). Get free devnet SOL from faucet.solana.com if you need it.
try_steps.see: The page lists initvault, initgames, addgame and closegame, and shows program Db4FmHGi…
try_steps.ran: The lab wallet BP1uwSaT… used the same IDL client.

try_steps.do: Submit initvault: generate a fresh vault keypair (it must sign), set admin to your wallet, and paste the six documented Pyth devnet feed addresses from the lesson.
try_steps.see: A confirmed transaction and a new vault account whose admin is you.

try_steps.do: Submit initgames with that vault and the games PDA seeds ["games", your pubkey].
try_steps.see: A games account with count=0 and symbol [ZEROAI Instant Win Games].

try_steps.do: Submit addgame with symbols [BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, DOGE, JUP] and six target prices, passing the same six Pyth accounts.
try_steps.see: count increments to 1. closeprice may be all zeros if the Pyth feeds are older than 60 seconds.
try_steps.ran: addgame sig 5JhYuu9ahn7requMU3kDpBWQPLzhomsKA7aFRr5kYSgQHtHBSpGuWwfMpxw1infNwAqju1wUQoTM6dXewnrzaNVa; count=1, closeprice all zeros (stale feeds).

try_steps.do: Try initvault again with the same vault keypair.

diagram:
admin ─ initvault(admin, 6 Pyth feeds) ─▶ Vault (signed account)
admin ─ initgames() ─▶ Games PDA ["games", admin]
admin ─ addgame(symbols, target prices, 6 Pyth accounts) ─▶ snapshot closeprice (0 if feed >60s old)
accounts: Stores admin and six Pyth feed addresses used later by addgame.
Prediction records: symbol, targetprice, closeprice, count, timestamp.
Accounts owned by gSbePebf… (classic Pyth on devnet)
Passed to addgame; must match the vault's stored feed addresses.

instructions.name: initvault
steps: Payer signs; the vault keypair also signs and is initialised with the provided Vault struct (admin + six feeds).

instructions.name: initgames
steps: Requires vault.has_one = admin. Creates the games PDA and emits GameEvent with count=0.

instructions.name: addgame
steps: Each Pyth account must match the vault feed. For every feed, get_price_no_older_than(..., 60) is recorded (or 0). count increments.

innovation.title: On-chain publication of an AI model's price predictions, checked against Pyth
innovation.text: The interesting DeAI idea is that ZEROAI's predicted prices are written to Solana and can be compared with a Pyth snapshot at the same moment, so later readers can audit the call. The program itself is a small admin-gated recorder, not an inference market or agent runtime.
innovation.more: closegame was not exercised in this run. Stale Pyth feeds yield closeprice 0.

frontend.title: Generic IDL console
steps: initvault needs a fresh vault keypair as a signer.
Then initgames and addgame against that vault.

exercises.title: Why was closeprice all zeros?
steps: Explain what happens when the feed is older than 60 seconds.
exercises.expect: The code pushes 0 when the Option is None; it does not fail the transaction.

exercises.title: Who can add a game?
steps: Look at the has_one = admin constraint on the vault.
exercises.expect: Only the admin stored on the vault can sign addgame / initgames.
exercises.hint: InitGames and AddGame both have has_one = admin.
exercises.approach: Read the account structs in initialize.rs and add.rs.

not_covered: closegame was not sent. Pyth close prices were zero because the classic devnet feeds were stale. The hosted UI was not clicked in headless Chromium in this run.
objectives: Create a vault of Pyth feed addresses and read it back from devnet.
Derive the games PDA and initialise it.
Explain why addgame can succeed with closeprice all zeros.

Comfort with Anchor accounts and Pyth price-feed accounts.
